strongest_proved_result: For every n-vertex graph sequence with e(G)>floor(n^2/4) and delta(G)>=n/2-o(n), every edge-colouring in which all C7 copies are rainbow uses at least n^2/8-o(n^2) colours.
new_proved_components: Quantified exact-four-path obstruction stability: at near-Dirac minimum degree, failure for one endpoint pair forces O((N-2delta+1)N) edit distance from balanced two-clique or complete-bipartite structure.
Closure of the R003 empty-common-neighbourhood near-two-clique branch.
Maximum-cut core/hub theorem for near-complete-bipartite graphs without an independent-side assumption.
Uniform epsilon-eta interface closing the BCM-style k=3 Case-2 induction step.
Exact reduction of the remaining Case 1 to distance-two/no-three-step or distance-three/disjoint-neighbourhood obstruction profiles.
remaining_bottleneck: Prove the parameterized Case-1 colour bound when delta is approximately (1/2-s)n for fixed s>0. Equivalently, close the two obstruction profiles at target (1/8+s/2+s^2/2-o(1))n^2 colours.

publication_guard.reason: The result is a substantial unbounded stability theorem, but the headline problem remains open, BCM26 announces an unspecified Case-2 argument, and exhaustive novelty plus specialist proof audits are still missing.

scope_guard: Finite checks guard formulas and templates only. They do not prove the asymptotic theorem or the original problem.
